cells.gaps: No source from the last three years says a standing body with members from outside government gave its view on a named digital law or policy. No report of the November 2024 hearing, or of comments received, has been found.
cells.note: HAMA's November 2024 public hearing on its web radio and television specifications was held because article 43 of the audiovisual communication law requires one, a yes to question 3, which by the study's rule answers the earlier ones. No standing body's view has been found.
